T: The island is erupting. The oven is on.
D: Owen and Claire go back to Isla Nublar to rescue the dinosaurs before a volcano wipes them out.
P: Serve dessert when the volcano blows on Isla Nublar.
S: Beef sausages grilled over coals, sliced with jammy onions and wholegrain mustard
Thick beef sausages grilled over coals, sliced and served on toothpicks with mustard and caramelised onion.
Lockwood auction smoked salmon on rye
the auction at the Lockwood mansion

Toasted rye squares topped with lemon crème fraîche, folds of smoked salmon, capers and dill, passed round on trays like at the auction. Cut 6 slices dark rye into quarters, brush with olive oil and toast at 180C for 8 minutes until crisp, then cool. Mix 150g crème fraîche with the zest of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt. Spread a little on each square, top with a fold of smoked salmon from 200g, 2 capers and a dill sprig. Finish with cracked pepper and serve within the hour.
Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in sausage meat and breadcrumbs, fried or baked, halved
Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in sausage meat, crumbed and cooked golden, then halved like cracked dinosaur eggs.
M: Lockwood Manor eye fillet with red wine jus

Beef eye fillet seared hard and roasted pink, sliced with a glossy red wine jus, creamy potato gratin and buttered green beans. Layer 1kg thinly sliced potatoes in a buttered dish with 300ml cream, 2 garlic cloves and salt, and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Season a 1kg eye fillet, sear all over in a hot pan and roast at 200C for 20 minutes for medium-rare, then rest 10 minutes. In the same pan, boil 250ml red wine and 250ml beef stock until reduced by half, then whisk in 30g butter. Blanch 300g green beans for 3 minutes.
Isla Nublar chilli lime chicken and beans
Chili lime grilled chicken thighs with rice and warm beans

Chicken thighs marinated in lime, garlic and chilli, chargrilled, served over rice and smoky black beans with a fresh tomato salsa. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side until charred. Cook 300g rice. Warm 2 drained cans black beans with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Dice 3 tomatoes with half a red onion and coriander. Serve the chicken over rice and beans with the salsa.
W: Bananas stuffed with chocolate and marshmallows, foil-wrapped and cooked on the barbecue

Bananas split in the skin and stuffed with dark chocolate and marshmallows, baked in foil until gooey, with crushed biscuits on top. Slit 4 bananas lengthways through the top skin without cutting through the bottom, and open them slightly. Stuff each with 25g chopped dark chocolate and a handful of mini marshmallows from 50g. Wrap each in foil and cook on a barbecue or at 200C in the oven for 10 minutes until melted. Open the foil, scatter with 4 crushed digestive biscuits and eat with spoons.
K: Blue butterfly pea tea with honey, topped with lemonade and lime

Butterfly pea tea chilled bright blue over ice, topped with lemonade, then a squeeze of lime that turns it purple at the table. Steep 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 500ml boiling water for 10 minutes, strain, stir in 3 tbsp honey and chill. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice and pour in the blue tea until half full. Top each with lemonade. Serve with lime wedges on the side and let everyone squeeze in the lime to watch the colour change.

steps.text: Cook the onions slowly in the oil with the sugar until jammy.
Grill the sausages over coals until blistered and cooked through.
Slice thickly, spear on toothpicks and serve with the onions and mustard.
Boil six of the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Wrap each egg in sausage meat, then roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Deep fry at 170C for 6 minutes, or bake at 200C for 25 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
